surface: src/plate_core/pr_babysit.py (cleanup_git_locks + verify_worktree_is_isolated public helpers; integrated into _perform_local_rebase + local-rebase path in babysit_pr + docstring), src/plate_core/agent_guidance.py (worktree verify/cleanup in Full PR Green), AGENTS.md (babysit section: patterns, lock cleanup, verify, no main checkout), plugin/agents/plate.agent.md (worktree note in babysit bullet), tests/test_pr_babysit.py (regression test for helpers + docs requirement)
summary: Improve worktree isolation robustness in pr-babysit skill: add public cleanup_git_locks() and verify_worktree_is_isolated() helpers; call them in local-rebase and rebase paths; update guidance/AGENTS/persona to mandate verify + lock cleanup before any worktree ops during babysit/fixes (never main checkout, explicit patterns for subagent coexistence, temp naming, git worktree remove + rmtree). Add regression test. (Addresses #514.)
migration_impact: Agents must now proactively verify isolation and cleanup locks when using worktrees for PR fixes or babysit local-rebase (via the new pr-babysit helpers or equivalent git commands). This prevents lock collisions, wrong-CWD edits, and main checkout pollution. Downstream agents following the plate persona/guidance will be more reliable in worktree scenarios. No breaking changes to existing call sites; helpers are additive.
agent_notes: Before any rebase, push, edit, or test run in a babysit/fix context: call cleanup_git_locks() (or rm -f .git/index.lock) and verify_worktree_is_isolated() (or git rev-parse --show-toplevel and check for worktree/temp/plate- indicators). Always operate in fresh isolated worktree for the PR branch (git worktree add ...); cd to it or use -C; verify toplevel; cleanup with git worktree remove --force + rm -rf on exit. Use the pr-babysit skill's local-rebase strategy or the helpers for encapsulation. See updated pr_babysit docstring, guidance Full PR Green, and AGENTS babysit details. (Addresses #514; complements local-rebase in #520-era babysit work.)
